messages:
maya: FYI  All-hands tomorrow 11:00 PT, 30m. Trying a slightly different format: 3 short updates + 10m AMA panel (exec + product + security). Drop Qs here or in the doc.

maya: Agenda (30m):
- 11:00-11:06 Exec update  Q3 priorities + hiring ask
- 11:06-11:12 Product spotlight  Private deployment pilot & API stability improvements
- 11:12-11:20 Security brief  Privacy Shield defaults + retention opt-in flow
- 11:20-11:30 AMA panel (pick top upvoted Qs)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-qna-q3panel (add + upvote)

ashwin: Product note: launching a 6-week pilot for Private deployments with 3 enterprise customers; goal is parity with hosted API for feature flags and telemetry. Will share onboarding checklist in the doc.

lina: Billing/ops heads-up: we're consolidating three internal metering systems into one billing pipeline over the next sprint; expect minor invoice id changes. We'll publish migration notes and contact points.

carla: Security: introducing "Privacy Shield" defaults for new projects (anonymized debug indices + 30d retention). Teams can opt in/out per-project. Added opt-out steps and an export sample in the Q&A doc.

ben: Runbook tweak: added a short verification step after failover and an automated postmortem trigger for Sev2+. Pasted runbook snippet in the doc. Export sample: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export -d '{"project":"projX","range":"30d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

maya: Recording + slides will be posted right after and an office hour will run tomorrow 16:00 PT for follow-ups. If you can't attend, add Qs to the doc and we'll address them in the AMA.

all-hands-bot: Event posted: All-hands  Q3 kickoff + AMA  Tomorrow 11:00 PT (link in #general).

recording-bot: Recording link (uploaded after meeting): https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1891234567-q3-kickoff-ama.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1891234567)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways (short):
- Exec: shifted priority to reliability + customer onboarding; hiring approved: +3 infra, +2 account success.
- Product: Private pilot started; goal: full feature parity in 6 weeks.
- Security: Privacy Shield default enabled for new projects; opt-out documented; migration/export guide live.
- Ops: billing pipeline consolidation planned; expect minor invoice id changes; runbook postmortem trigger enabled.

maya: Action items: 1) Teams running private pilots please fill onboarding checklist in the doc. 2) Managers: headcount asks in hiring tracker by EOD. We'll follow up on unanswered Qs in-thread and update the public notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
